lines.text: Hello, have a seat. What's happened to the wrist?
I slipped on the ice and landed on it, I'm coming in with pain on the thumb side of my right wrist.
Last Thursday. There's tingling in my fingertips as well, at least I think it's tingling, it's hard to describe.
Hello, sorry I'm late, I couldn't find anywhere to park. I'm Dev, I brought her in.
No problem, come in and pull up a chair. We were just getting started.
I told her to see a GP after she heard a crack when she landed.
That's helpful, thank you. I'm going to press on a few spots, tell me if anything's sharp.
You're tender in the hollow at the base of the thumb, which is where the scaphoid bone sits.
I'd like you seen at the fracture clinic today, so I'll ring them now and keep it in this splint until then.
I can drive her straight there.
